measurement_method.transfer: wall time of serialized cudaMemcpyAsync plus stream synchronization; nonnegative linear fit
measurement_method.launch: wall time of empty launch plus stream synchronization
measurement_method.pump: host enqueue time of one pinned 4KiB H2D, empty kernel, and pinned 4KiB D2H; excludes final wait
measurement_method.cpu_compute: four independent multiply-add recurrences per element, 256 steps, FMA counts as two ops
measurement_method.gpu_compute: same recurrence workload timed with CUDA events
measurement_method.memory: array triad; traffic counts two reads and one write
measurement_method.packing: single-thread gather/scatter at stride four into pinned storage; payload bytes only
measurement_method.cpu_workers: measured with cpu_threads minus one, reserving one thread for the GPU pump
measurement_method.compatibility: schema, CPU name, GPU UUID/compute capability, toolchain versions, precision, CPU threads

measurement_method.samples: median of five warmed observations; maximum median across allocation sizes and planning cases
measurement_method.cold_driver_startup: CUDA set-device and primary-context initialization in five fresh processes; no OS cold-state claim
measurement_method.gpu_setup: complete warm GPU scope lifecycle: create, first enter/leave, and close including mandatory stream/pool destruction
measurement_method.register: three-dimensional whole-root registration with negative lower bounds; unregister excluded
measurement_method.host_access: read access begin/end to an already-current host rectangle; no transfer
measurement_method.device_access: access begin/end to an already-allocated device rectangle; no transfer or wait
measurement_method.allocation: first device begin/end and completion wait on undefined storage; includes access bookkeeping
measurement_method.release: unregister of allocated undefined storage and completion wait; includes unregister bookkeeping
measurement_method.wait: common-runtime completion wait after an empty kernel; enqueue excluded
measurement_method.launch_enqueue: empty kernel enqueue, CUDA error check, and runtime launch notification; final wait excluded
measurement_method.planning: actual bounded common-runtime candidate simulation; 1/4/16 mixed units with full, opposite-face, and eight-rectangle effects; complete duration divided by reported work count
measurement_method.accounting: management costs are conservative complete-call costs; allocation/release can include bookkeeping charged elsewhere

measurement_method.staging: actual shared two-slot acquire/release; cold allocation and cached reuse measured separately
measurement_method.packing: exact physical rectangular row copies into/from pinned storage; conservative contiguous bandwidth plus nonnegative per-row overhead from thin rows
measurement_method.events: non-default stream completion event record and completed-event wait measured separately
measurement_method.batch_prepare: actual metadata-only versioned batch preview divided by its reported preparation work; no callback execution
measurement_method.aggregation: maximum median fixed costs per slot payload; minimum contiguous bandwidth and maximum nonnegative thin-row residual across bounded observations
measurement_method.pipeline: model includes preparation, initial immutable uploads, per-batch launches/events, fill and drain; no online timing feedback

runtime_provenance.identity: full compiler manifest SHA256; unknown fields are explicit
runtime_provenance.events: actual API submissions and coherence commits; no physical execution timestamps
runtime_provenance.initial_context_creation: unknown until the source coordinator binds its owner
runtime_provenance.batch_worker_attribution: unavailable; batch callbacks cannot call context APIs
runtime_provenance.execution_error_attribution: unavailable; existing numerical errors are unchanged
runtime_provenance.disabled: no context lookup, allocations, coherence changes or numerical errors

task_acquisition.validation: all resource effects before transfers or numerical execution
task_acquisition.host_completion: one completion for task downloads; independent and disjoint accesses do not wait
task_acquisition.upload_lifetime: exact pending DMA read sections; completion events precede unrelated numerical work

graph_execution.queue_lifetime: owned kernel argument bytes and effects span generated helper calls
graph_execution.host_boundaries: drain conflicting tasks and their dependencies; retain independent queued work
graph_execution.planning: pending task writes contribute virtual definitions without premature physical commits
graph_execution.budget_eviction: whole-task reservation pins its footprint; pressure flushes queued arguments before exact dirty publication and LRU retirement
graph_execution.effects: ordered original task effects with one atomic coherence commit
graph_execution.residency: canonical context buffers shared across submissions and iterations
graph_execution.replay: context-owned CUDA executable graph; current kernel parameters updated before launch
graph_execution.submission_policy: first matching topology uses direct launches; second builds a graph; later reaches replay; topology changes restart warmup
graph_execution.warmup_evidence: graph_warmup_direct plus actual direct_submissions/direct_kernels; never graph_resource_fallbacks
graph_execution.fallback: before numerical submission only; graph resource failure uses ordered direct launches
graph_execution.definition_kill: semantic coverage changes retain physical freshness; explicit discard retires dead values

idle_execution_resources.contents: completed stream and allocation-free CUDA memory pool only
idle_execution_resources.freshness: all identities, definitions and coherence are invocation-local
idle_execution_resources.trace_reuse: FORT_SCOPED initialize_reuse; bytes is retained pool capacity
idle_execution_resources.legacy_allocations: logical field allocations, including reused physical pages
idle_execution_resources.failure: poisoned or incomplete resources are never cached
idle_execution_resources.close_completion: stream-ordered publication and field/scratch retirement share one wait

borrowed_views.coordinates: canonical root physical origins and pitches; child logical bounds and extents
borrowed_views.allocation: borrow existing full-layout root; no independent registration or device buffer
borrowed_views.aliases: bounded exact read unions; writable formal views must be disjoint
borrowed_views.bounds: checked original descriptor generation and existing INTEGER ABI

rank_reduced.coordinates: root-rank origins; logical-rank extents and distinct retained-axis mapping
rank_reduced.footprints: exact rectangular planes; omitted axes select one original coordinate
rank_reduced.strides: original root pitches; initial actual views retain unit logical strides

planning_candidate_memo.storage: bounded metadata LRU; owned exact keys and worker choice vectors only
planning_candidate_memo.eligibility: validated fresh host-only graph query; no pending work, device allocation or scratch
planning_candidate_memo.key: full numeric model, canonical alias incidence, geometry, effects and observed placement environment
planning_candidate_memo.reuse: reprice all-native and cached candidate with current simulator, work and profitability gates
planning_candidate_memo.authority: current definition proof, hardware/profile, floating-point and worker binding guards remain required
planning_candidate_memo.reporting: actual key/lookup duration traced; unpriced memo work invalidates complete and owner estimates
planning_candidate_memo.limitation: conservative candidate reuse; cached native choices do not search for newly profitable alternatives
planning_candidate_memo.failure: unknown metadata or optional allocation failure uses ordinary planning

native_owner_hint.authority: conservative original-native scheduling hint; no plan, definition or data authority
native_owner_hint.observation_bracket: normal successful root completion with no live contexts, GPU choice/attempt/acceptance or unexpected runtime error
native_owner_hint.key: copied source/profile/policy/descriptor metadata plus original entry CPU/OpenMP/FP/environment
native_owner_hint.entry_environment: shared exact collector with placement memo; no CUDA initialization or payload reads
native_owner_hint.quality_limit: native hits can suppress newly profitable work until the forced ordinary reprobe

planning_numerical_costs.basis: static scalar intrinsic counts and compatible independent offline holdouts
planning_numerical_costs.missing_or_incompatible: unknown estimate; automatic placement remains native

planning_compute_costs.basis: complete compute seconds; original Fortran and generated workers calibrated independently
planning_compute_costs.native_operation_cpu: actual coordinated host execution including candidate-only preparation
planning_compute_costs.separate_costs: transfers, allocation, launches, synchronization and coordination
planning_compute_costs.applicability: original compiler semantics, fixed CPU placement, workload class and runtime item range
planning_compute_costs.missing_or_incompatible: definition validation retained; automatic estimate unavailable
planning_compute_costs.continuation: coherent host counterfactual; no replay of earlier numerical work
planning_compute_costs.compatibility: v1/v2 planning interfaces retain their original meaning

numerical_environment.requires: original nontrapping round-to-nearest thread; native IEEE guards stay in place
numerical_environment.runtime_setup: preserve caller flags, rounding and trap mask

collective_automatic_calibration.requirement: offline persistent-team rates and exact emitted coordination, fixed team and toolchain
collective_automatic_calibration.missing_or_incompatible: uniform unchanged native execution before numerical work

planning_continuation.native_unit_effects: independent original-native proof; exact current all-CPU worker range only
planning_continuation.native_unit_costs: uncalibrated original-native substitution invalidates pending and owner estimates
planning_continuation.suffix_boundary: compiler-proved prework boundary only; accepted prefix commands and versions retained
planning_continuation.costs: incremental execution plus change in eventual publication/teardown liability
planning_continuation.terminal_operations: hypothetical until owner close; excluded from executed segment counters
planning_continuation.native_selection: execute reached segment with coherence hooks; retain owning context
planning_continuation.owner_estimate: unavailable if a pending segment report is superseded or an original-source suffix is used

scratch.storage: cached context-owned device arena; no host binding or publication
scratch.ordering: existing context stream; growth waits for earlier use before replacement
scratch.budget: cached capacity and registered field payload share the context device budget
scratch.zero_bytes: null pointer with a release-required token; no CUDA initialization
scratch.automatic_costs: unavailable until numerical integration prices scratch lifetime costs
scratch.compatibility: existing field statistics and runtime interfaces remain unchanged

scope_transfers.pinned_execution: synchronous exact-section packing, copy, completion and unpack
scope_transfers.staging_streams: two reusable non-default streams in the process-wide pool
scope_transfers.budget_scope: active, allocating and cached staging for scoped and chunked/hybrid calls
scope_transfers.automatic_placement: calibrated pinned synchronous pricing; pipelined/auto retain direct placement baseline and select transfers for approved GPU subchains

coalesced_execution.direction: upload only; output sections remain exact
coalesced_execution.source_requirement: whole canonical source resource is defined and host current
coalesced_execution.coordinates: original full-layout pitches and logical coordinates
coalesced_execution.placement: cost-selected plans use exact direct transfers until coalesced costs are calibrated
coalesced_execution.actual_bytes: normal upload statistics; upload_coalesced trace records actual span bytes

batch.preview: compatible=-1; metadata only; no callback, CUDA, schedule consumption or coherence changes
batch.callback: complete source-proven GPU subchain; full-layout views and original coordinates; no reentrant context calls
batch.concurrency: one active batch per context; two non-default staging streams
batch.completion: both slots complete before return or native boundary
batch.costs: offline staging/row packing/events/preparation plus compute, launch and pinned transfer rates; fill/drain included
batch.cost_reporting: execution and terminal delta separate; unrepriced complete-owner estimate is unavailable
batch.failure: unapplied fallback preserves schedule; started execution errors poison the context and prohibit replay

runtime.section_coordinates: zero-based physical offsets, exclusive upper bounds
runtime.concurrent_access: separate contexts with nonconflicting host storage

base_profile.identity_checked: CPU, toolchain, precision and thread budget; current GPU/runtime/driver verified by new scoped measurements
